notes.title: Patch v.250717
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here we are with a new update! Not much new content this time, I have to admit, but over the past month the game has gone through major internal optimizations that should make the experience smoother. I’m also working towards a future console release, and there’s still a lot to do.

I want to sincerely thank everyone who’s playing and sharing valuable feedback—everything is being considered and evaluated.

There’s a lot of new content coming in the future for Ink., including 5 new chapters which are already in their final stages, but you’ll need to wait a little longer.

Thanks again for your patience! I hope you’re enjoying exploring the world inside the book.

Here are the (brief) patch notes:
- general performances optimization (which includes a lot of stuff)
- improved quality of ink color traces
- game background has been darkened to be softer on the eyes

[img]https://i.gyazo.com/682e28559ff7a57cc96cda4a4d242419.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch v.250611
notes.notes:
Hi all, sorry for the long delay!
In these hot days we've been busy optimizing some stuff in the game and building the grounds for the future console version of Ink. 
We're always working on updating graphics and art, and improving gameplay based on your feedbacks, so thank you!

[b]Here's what changed in this new version:[/b]
- blue pages and intro clip have new music!
- new loading screen covers for all characters
- new character selection images and boss-intros for all characters

[b]Improvements[/b]
- general performance optimizations
- Skrat weapon's text stats readability has been improved
- changed default values for some options (new players only)

[b]Fixes[/b]
- when using an Amulet, pages with only open chest's shells in it no longer prints a "?" on the map
- enemies now stop properly when "ANDANTE" book modifier is active
- skrat weapon's names has been adjusted for: English
- fixed UI buttons not displaying correctly in inventory and on NPCs when using a dualshock controller

notes.title: Update v.250208
notes.notes:
This patch includes a series of small fixes about pages generations and some quality of life improvements.
A lot of new stuff will come in the next patch happening (hopefully) later this month.

[h1]New[/h1]
- black pages can now appear after opening too many blue pages

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
- blue doors are previewed when you have ether bubbles
- ether floor now cast reflections
- duplicating a shop can lead to have multiples of the same object. The following now works in multiple copies: Lightbulb, Hot pepper
- blue page's doors can no longer spawn when trying to connect a page with an enclosed area

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- special pages no longer drop rewards when completing if there were enemies in it
- map can now be opened while viewing stuff in the inventory
- final pages of a path now are guaranteed to drop a reward when completing
- dodging tutorial has been simplified 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- fixed an edge case when connecting pages with blue ink
- fixed rare page generation failure when player uses instant camera on certain chapter layouts
- prevented potential infinite loop by buying an instant camera and duplicating the shop that sold it
- background blur now works properly with active post processing
- obscurity details has been restored

notes.title: Update v.250127
notes.notes:
[b]Start unlocking![/b]
With this update players can start unlock new stuff, like new cards and special pages. This will lead to a lot of new combinations of fun gameplay.

[h1]New[/h1]
- feature "unlock stuff" is now available, this means that you will unlock new cards and various stuff by playing
- enciclopedia is now available after beating the first chapter with Spok
- game fonts has been changed to support all characters for future translated versions
- the Gem Statue (rare encounter)

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
- updated grading score calculations so that max grade is more easier to achieve
- shop's boxes are now a lighter color to improve readability
- changed note background sprite when viewing effects on Smuk's weapon pieces and weapon sets
- explosions performances has been slightly optimized
- chapter name is now visible when viewing the map fullscreen (default by holding TAB)
- modified background note for card synergies popup
- new sound fx & particles when entering a new page where there is a code for the safe

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- blessing "Mass Blindness" has been changed from "chapter" to "10 pages"

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- fixed border collisions disappearing after doing a quick restart
- updated some pages' layout
- fixed an issue where setting an invalid command in keybind settings would cause the menus to permanently lock up
- fixed a visual bug on fullscreen map where semi-hidden visited-uncompleted pages didn't display their texture properly
- updated text alignment of some elements when viewing unlocks
- fixed an issue where entering the elevator with global blindness causes the player to flash
- "Witch" is now visible in the enciclopedia
- "Ponky" stats now registers correctly in the enciclopedia
- fixed cards sinergies text in Barter's dialogs
- fixed enemies keep their status effects when they split
- fixed door obstructions when creating a connection between pages with Blue ink 
- tutorial "health system" now works properly

notes.title: Update v.250119
notes.notes:
This version introduces a series of small updates for version 250114 and some new quality of life improvements.

[h1]New[/h1]
- luck modifier has been reworked to be more consistent and more easy to understand
- luck modifier is now visible in "active effects" tab in inventory
- added option when pausing to quick restart a game from beginning
- hidden upgrades are now hinted when upgrading weapon parts with Smuk
- Smuk's "Rear Sub" weapon piece has been upgraded
- card "Super Glue" has been reworked, can still be purchased from the pirate in the Black Market pgae

[h1]General Improvements & Fixes[/h1]
- enemies now spawn at the same time with all props when entering a page
- batteries indicator is now visible when viewing "Mixer" using Spok
- when player invincibility status effect goes off a new sound effect has been added
- grade now starts from a much higher value (now 66/100, was 50/100) and improved balancing on score calculations
- pages generation improved for special pages
- collision sliding has been fixed
- corner collisions has been improved
- tesla tower traps now flicker when they're about to shoot
- blessing effects now does not decrease when completing chapter's starting page
- Hydrant and Guumo contact damage has been removed
- blessing effects have been reorganized to better match their category icon depending on their duration (black: chapter, blue: pages)

notes.title: Update version 250114
notes.notes:
[b][h1]What's new[/h1][/b]
- new object: instant camera
- post-processing has now multiple options and its been rewritten, you can choose between:
  * OFF: no post-processing
  * SOFT: subtle and darker effect that has a soft impact on the eyes 
  * LUMINOUS: give colors a more alive-feeling
- color stains now applies on enemies and objects (this can be turned off in graphic options if desired)
- cards now have a new textured background and change their border color based on their upgrade level
- added a full-screen animation when the card "Signed Contract" activate its effect
- new grading system for in-game score
- game time and game grade will now show after taking the final elevator
- change in layouts: for each page the position and number of neighbours now heavily impact the loaded type of layout
  * this change may modify generation on old saved seeds

[b][h1]General Improvements & Fixes[/h1][/b]
- when viewing inventory, game's audio get slightly distorted to increase the feeling of "isolation"
- objects transformed by the Amulet are now indicated properly on the map
- improvements for Zeek: its defensive attacks are now much more consistent and reliable
- when a fullscreen tutorial appear, players will get immunity frames if enemy bubbles are on the screen
- controls: roll input can be used to go back when navigating in the inventory (keyboard only)
- updated some pages for a better design
- blue ether blessings now don't deplete automatically when clearing pages but only when you open a blue door
- collision are more consistent on corners (box, columns, rocks)
- fixed issue with "Blue ink" where players were able to link two pages from illegal spots
- some pages have been re-designed because they were too unfair
- "Discount Time!" blessing now appear only if a Shop is available in the current chapter (although it applies to cards upgrade prices as well)

[b][h1]Visual Changes[/h1][/b]
- fixed weapon clipping through elevator borders
- added occasional oil spills to oil bubbles
- bombs and explosive barrels now get drawn correctly when transitioning pages
- added a clock icon on temporary cards in inventory
- spikes get slightly darker when they close after completing a page

notes.title: Update & Fixes for v.241219
notes.notes:
[b]New[/b]
- added a new tutorial in the tutorial machine: Health 
- game timer now is continuous and doesn't pause (except in pause menu). This is useful to time speedruns

[b]General Improvements & Fixes[/b]
- Gem of Life now transfer more valuable items more consistently
- door lockers now are visually off when you cannot interact with them
- fixed text in inventory for active effects that stays for one or more chapters
- improved quality of global obscurity
- global mist disappear gradually if global obscurity is visible
- fixed a page where an Hydrant was unreachable

notes.title: Chapter 4 "From slime they grow" update!
notes.notes:
With chapter 4 release you'll have access to a whole new section of the game. We are coming very close to having a full and complete run in standard mode for Ink.

[b]What is "Standard Mode" ?[/b]
Ink. will have various modes for you to play. 
Standard mode is a normal run that consists beating chapters 1 to 5. In a future update alternative chapters will be added, letting you choose the path you prefer to complete a run.
Different paths will lead to different rewards, but we'll talk about that in the future.

[b]What's new in this Update?[/b]
Here's a list of what I've added and changed in this version.

New
- added chapter 4: "from slime they grow" with 200 new pages
- added 10 new enemies for chapter 4 and one new boss
- added new cards, also "TIER 4" cards can now be found
- added new pages for chapter 1 and 2
- new trap: blob turret (can be found in chapter 3)
- new tutorial system implemented in the starting page (not finished, feedback is very appreciated)

General Improvements & Fixes
- explosions now deals more damages in far-areas
- force fields now flash in order if they are placed or ordered as a chain
- fixed a crash with the card "Scissors" when splitting an enemy

notes.title: Update v.241207
notes.notes:
Improved the quality of some tutorials to make them clearer. This should improve gameplay readability for some key mechanics that some players don't use often.
As always, feedback is highly appreciated.

Sneak peak of next week update:
- new trap: Blob turrets in Chapter 3 pages
- new pages
- start the implementation of chapter 4

notes.title: Small Update v.241115
notes.notes:
This is just a small update to improve the readability of the tutorial machine in the starting page. I saw that some people were confused about how the dodge mechanic actually works, and now it's been specified that by dodging you can avoid any type of danger, from obstacles like spikes, to enemies and their shots.

New:
- (keyboard) you can now use your mouse to open the book at the start of the game
- added blur effect under the tutorial screen
